Demo.Title: ComboBox without animation
Demo.Note: Class="noanim": the list appears and goes at once. Raven's animations are global (Rset_animations_enabled), so demos.c turns them off while such a widget is used.

ComboBox.Tooltip: This one is animated, to compare

Demo.Title: Reorderable ListView
Demo.Note: Drag a row to another place, or select one and press Alt+Up / Alt+Down. Raven's ListView cannot reorder: src/reorder.c moves the texts.
